## `ew export bom`

```text
ew export bom [--project <project>] [--block <block>] [--mode <mode>] [--format <format>] [--out <out>] [--json]
```

Stability: preview.

| Flag | Takes a value | Repeatable |
|---|---|---|
| `--project` | yes | no |
| `--block` | yes | no |
| `--mode` | yes | no |
| `--format` | yes | no |
| `--out` | yes | no |
| `--json` | no | no |

**Exit codes**

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | success |
| 2 | usage and open errors, a project without the block, an unknown or wrong block |

**Result** (`--json`): `ew.export-bom-result/1`, schema [`ew.export-bom-result-1.schema.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/bin/ew/schemas/ew.export-bom-result-1.schema.json).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `$schema` | `"ew.export-bom-result/1"` | yes |  | The name of this schema. |
| `csv` | string or `null` | no |  | The CSV text when there is no `--out`; `null` with one. |
| `out` | string or `null` | no |  | The file the CSV was written to (`--out`); `null` without one. |
| `rows` | integer (format `uint`, min 0) | yes |  | The rows (data and heading rows, the header line excluded). |
